chapter_title: Chương 283: Tình huynh đệ là chân ái (0284)

segments.title: Chương 283: Tình huynh đệ là chân ái (0284)
segments.content:
Xie Yang's house was already renovated, but it needed to air out for a while before he could move in.

He was walking into the Huaqing Jiayuan residential complex tonight because he had received a call from Chen Guiliang. For some reason, Chen had asked him to come over for a few drinks and even told him to bring some snacks to go with the alcohol.

"Ding-dong, ding-dong!"

The doorbell rang for over twenty seconds before the door slowly opened.

Xie Yang walked into the living room and looked around: "This renovation is pretty good. The previous owner had great taste."

Xie Sao Bang actually liked this style too.

Because it looked classy.

Chen Guiliang took the barbecue and braised dishes from his hands and carried them straight to the rooftop: "If you want cold ones, get them from the fridge yourself."

Xie Yang didn't stand on ceremony with him, finding the fridge and grabbing a bunch of beers.

All the lights in the rooftop garden were on, shaped like ancient lanterns. There were more than ten cans of beer by Chen Guiliang's feet, and he had already laid out the snacks and chopsticks.

Xie Yang felt that something was off with Chen Guiliang today: "You called me here to admire the moon? There isn't much of a moon today."

"Just to have a few drinks with you. It's been a while since we drank together." Chen Guiliang pulled the tab on a beer can.

Xie Yang tossed Chen Guiliang a Huazi cigarette, then lit one for himself and said, "You son of a... Are you troubled by something tonight?"

Chen Guiliang smiled: "You've stopped cussing now? Or just not in front of me?"

Xie Yang still had the habit of flicking his hair. He flicked it dramatically now and said with immense arrogance, "Isn't the company about to go public? As a senior executive of a publicly listed company, how can I use foul language? I have to maintain a positive image."

"Like hell you maintain anything in private." Chen Guiliang raised his beer.

Xie Yang opened a cold one and clinked it against his, taking a huge gulp. He looked at the logo on the can and sighed with emotion, "Three years ago, the only beer I could drink was Blue Sword, and the only cigarettes I could smoke were hard-pack white Hongmei. I'd feel the pinch even buying a soft-pack yellow Hongmei, let alone something like Hongtashan. Now I can drink Budweiser and smoke Zhonghua whenever I want. It's fucking like a dream."

Chen Guiliang asked, "Do you think you've changed?"

Xie Yang thought carefully: "I've become more confident, more diligent, and more self-disciplined. I used to be addicted to 'Legend' and 'The World of Legend,' saving my meal money to pull all-nighters at internet cafes. Now, I have no interest in playing them. I just think those games are quite childish."

"Who asked you to toot your own horn? I'm asking if the way you treat people and handle things has changed," Chen Guiliang said with a smile.

Xie Yang nodded: "Of course it has. Let me think... When you first promoted me, I was actually very insecure. I felt like I didn't know anything. I was afraid people would laugh at me for getting in through the back door, afraid they'd laugh at my incompetence. The higher my position in the company, the stronger this feeling became. Sometimes I'd even dream that I'd messed things up, turned against you, and got kicked out. I'd be jolted awake by nightmares in the middle of the night."

"Hahaha, you sure have a lot of drama going on in your head." Chen Guiliang couldn't help but laugh.

Xie Yang continued, "Later on, work became smoother and smoother, and I handled things with ease. I felt myself getting a big head, thinking I was so damn awesome, a genius. How should I put it? I was often arrogant and started talking big."

Chen Guiliang asked, "How come I never noticed you in that state?"

"No matter how conceited I got, could I really act that way in front of you?" Xie Yang took another drink. "It was mainly with my relatives, friends, subordinates, and old classmates. I especially loved to show off, and sometimes I'd hurt people with my words."

Chen Guiliang asked, "How did you realize it later?"

Xie Yang recalled, "One time, I called my brother. We had barely spoken a few sentences when I started mocking him for being a civil servant, saying it was boring and that he worked like a dog all day without making much money. I told him he should just quit and come help me, and I even said I could easily get him a certain annual salary."

"Did your brother scold you?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Xie Yang nodded. "He gave me a good chewing out, said I was getting more and more arrogant. He said I got lucky and met a benefactor, and with a little success, I'd lost all sense of proportion. He said if I wasn't working with you, I'd just be a student from a crappy second-tier university... Anyway, he yelled at me for a long time. I got so angry I just hung up. Then I lay in bed, tossing and turning, unable to sleep. In the middle of the night, I picked up my phone and called him back. That night, my brother and I talked for the entire night."

Chen Guiliang said with feeling, "You have a good brother."

"What on earth happened to you? The company is doing really well now," Xie Yang asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "It's nothing. Let's drink!"

Chen Guiliang had suddenly asked Xie Yang for a drink because he realized he himself had changed.

Back when he first transmigrated, he was chatting with Xie Yang by the university's artificial lake, saying he wanted a relationship that had nothing to do with money. He wanted to experience true love.

Chen Guiliang knew very well that Bian Guanyue had truly fallen in love with him, and it indeed had nothing to do with money.

But what about Chen Guiliang himself?

When he received Bian Guanyue's call this evening, she had tacitly accepted Tao Xue's existence. After hanging up, Chen Guiliang didn't feel the joy he had expected. Instead, he felt lost and guilty.

It seemed he had never once considered Bian Guanyue's feelings.

What was even more terrifying was that Chen Guiliang realized he had changed, becoming so unrecognizable that he was a stranger to himself.

He said he would be prudent when alone, that he would reflect on himself three times a day.

But he couldn't do it at all.

Easier said than done.

He was just an ordinary person. The unity of knowledge and action was pure nonsense.

Xie Yang, unaware of Chen Guiliang's inner thoughts, started chatting about people and things from the past: "Did you know? Teacher Liu and Teacher Gao were poached by a school in the next city."

Liu Shuying and Gao Zhan had changed jobs?

Chen Guiliang shook his head: "I didn't know."

Xie Yang said, "That couple, one is a master teacher, the other a senior teacher. They also taught you, and they've produced a provincial top scorer and three city top scorers. The school that poached them from the next city was very generous, giving them 200,000 yuan in cash, a Volkswagen sedan, and a three-bedroom apartment."

Chen Guiliang smiled: "That's not bad. They worked for half their lives, and by the time we were in our third year of high school, Teacher Gao could only afford a Chery QQ."

The hidden information behind this was that some local schools were starting to use unscrupulous methods to snatch up educational resources. First, they poached teachers, and next, they would start poaching students.

Good schools would get better and better, while bad schools would get worse and worse.

Xie Yang smiled, "I heard some schools tried to poach Teacher Li too, and it was a school from Rongcheng. But Teacher Li didn't leave."

A school from Rongcheng coming to poach Li Runze was definitely related to Chen Guiliang.

Not to mention how successful Chen Guiliang was in business, he had already caused quite a stir with the essay competition back then and had actually gotten the annotations in the language textbook revised. As Chen Guiliang's language teacher, who was also a master teacher himself, it was only normal for him to be targeted by other schools.

But Li Runze was already content to coast. No matter how good the offer was, he was too lazy to move from the small county town.

Because by staying at the No. 2 County High School, he could basically do whatever he wanted. He could even give the new principal an attitude whenever he pleased. And the new principal would have to coax him!

Xie Yang took another sip of beer, sounding a bit wistful, "Zhou Jing has a boyfriend."

"How do you know?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Xie Yang said, "Wang Lei's university is very close to hers. Wang Lei told me. He said he saw Zhou Jing shopping with a guy one day. Wang Lei even went to say hi, and Zhou Jing introduced him as her boyfriend. Damn it, Wang Lei said the guy is pretty handsome."

Although Xie Yang had often been "fickle" in high school, claiming to like any pretty girl he saw, he had, after all, had a crush on Zhou Jing for three years and had even confessed to her at the farewell dinner after the college entrance exams.

Xie Yang felt a strange pang in his heart, but it wasn't as painful as he might have imagined.

It was like having a tiny splinter stuck in his flesh. He usually felt nothing, but when it was touched, he'd hiss in pain.

Chen Guiliang leaned back in a traditionally-woven rattan chair, sitting under a grape arbor and swirling the beer in his hand.

Having an old friend to drink and chat with made him feel much better.

He picked up his phone and sent a text to Bian Guanyue: "I'm sorry."

Bian Guanyue replied: "Mm."

Chen Guiliang texted again: "I will be twice as good to you."

Bian Guanyue took a long time to reply: "It's getting late, I'm going to sleep."

When he went back to his hometown that year, Chen Guiliang had explained the situation to Tao Xue, telling her he was already in a relationship. But Tao Xue had cried her eyes out, and Chen Guiliang's heart softened, so he continued to drag things out.

That wasn't right either. He couldn't push all the responsibility onto Tao Xue. Chen Guiliang himself had entertained the idea of having both.

Most men have had such thoughts. It's just a matter of whether they have the ability and the courage to take that step.

Now that things had reached this point, even if Chen Guiliang deeply reflected on himself, he couldn't just kick Tao Xue away and go back to how things were.

He could only be twice as good to Bian Guanyue to make up for his mistakes.

Xie Yang was still rambling beside him, "Damn it. When I was studying, I always thought that once I became successful, I'd drive a luxury car to go after Zhou Jing. Now I haven't even had time to buy the luxury car, and she already has a boyfriend."

Chen Guiliang said, "Just find someone else. What you're still holding onto is probably your own youthful infatuation, not a true love for any particular girl."

"That's possible," Xie Yang analyzed himself seriously. "I didn't love Zhou Jing that much. After I started working, I didn't even think about her for a year or two. It was only when I suddenly heard she had a boyfriend that I felt like I'd lost something."

"Drink up. Let's not talk about that crap."

"Cheers!"

Xie Yang finished a can and opened another. On a whim, he called Xu Haibo: "Bobo, are you asleep?"

"What do you want?" Xu Haibo said irritably.

Xie Yang pressed the speakerphone button: "I'm drinking with Big Boss Chen. Wanna join for a couple?"

Xu Haibo was speechless: "Am I supposed to fly over there?"

Xie Yang said, "Go buy some alcohol. We can drink while on the phone."

Xu Haibo cursed, "Are you nuts!" Then he added, "You should've said so earlier. The dorms are already locked at this hour. Where am I supposed to buy alcohol?"

Chen Guiliang shouted from the side, "You can substitute water for wine. It's fine if you drink plain water."

Xu Haibo actually went and poured a glass of plain water, raising it to the phone as if to clink glasses: "A long-distance toast to you two. We'll drink in person when you come to Rongcheng someday."

"Bottoms up," Xie Yang laughed heartily. "I love you, Bobo!"

Xu Haibo cursed, "Get lost. I like women."

Chen Guiliang shouted, "Bobo, be careful next time you see Xie Yang. This kid's sexual orientation changed after Zhou Jing got a boyfriend."

"For real?" Xu Haibo actually seemed to believe it for a second.

Xie Yang quickly explained, "Fuck, I'm not gay. It was just a joke!"

"Hahaha!" Chen Guiliang burst out laughing.

It really was happier being with his brothers. The more brothers, the merrier. More women was just a headache.
